metas.name: The Conjuring 2
metas.description: Same haunted-house team, bigger scares. Lorraine and Ed Warren travel to north London to help a single mother raising four children alone in a house plagued by malicious spirits.

metas.name: Insidious
metas.description: Astral possession horror from the Conjuring director. A family discovers that dark spirits have invaded their home after their son inexplicably falls into an endless sleep. When they reach out to a professional for help, they learn things are a lot more personal than they thought.

metas.name: It Follows
metas.description: Slow-burn supernatural dread. A young woman is followed by an unknown supernatural force after a sexual encounter.

metas.name: The Descent
metas.description: Claustrophobic creature survival. After a personal tragedy, Sarah joins her friends on a caving expedition in the Appalachian Mountains. But when a rockfall traps them deep underground, their adventure turns into a nightmare. As they search for a way out, the group discovers they are not alone—lurking in the darkness are savage, cave-dwelling creatures. With rising tension and dwindling trust, the women must fight to survive against both the predators and each other.

metas.name: A Quiet Place Part II
metas.description: Picks up right after the first one. Following the events at home, the Abbott family now face the terrors of the outside world. Forced to venture into the unknown, they realize that the creatures that hunt by sound are not the only threats that lurk beyond the sand path.

metas.name: 28 Days Later
metas.description: Where 28 Years Later started. Twenty-eight days after a killer virus was accidentally unleashed from a British research facility, a small group of London survivors are caught in a desperate struggle to protect themselves from the infected. Carried by animals and humans, the virus turns those it infects into homicidal maniacs -- and it's absolutely impossible to contain.

metas.name: The Day After Tomorrow
metas.description: Big-scale weather disaster; The Wave and Twisters lineage. After paleoclimatologist Jack Hall is largely ignored by UN officials when presenting his environmental concerns about the beginning of a new Ice Age, his research proves true when a superstorm develops, setting off catastrophic natural disasters throughout the world. Trying to get to his son, Sam, who is trapped in New York City with his friend Laura and others, Jack and his crew must travel to get to Sam before it's too late.

metas.name: Smile 2
metas.description: Relentless supernatural horror sequel. About to embark on a new world tour, global pop sensation Skye Riley begins experiencing increasingly terrifying and inexplicable events. Overwhelmed by the escalating horrors and the pressures of fame, Skye is forced to face her dark past to regain control of her life before it spirals out of control.

metas.name: Companion
metas.description: Sci-fi horror with a Ready or Not streak of dark comedy. During a weekend getaway at a secluded lakeside estate, a group of friends finds themselves entangled in a web of secrets, deception, and advanced technology. As tensions rise and loyalties are tested, they uncover unsettling truths about themselves and the world around them.

metas.name: Alien: Romulus
metas.description: Back-to-basics Alien horror. While scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station, a group of young space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life form in the universe.

metas.name: Prey
metas.description: Survival action with a Predator; period setting too. When danger threatens her camp, the fierce and highly skilled Comanche warrior Naru sets out to protect her people. But the prey she stalks turns out to be a highly evolved alien predator with a technically advanced arsenal.

metas.name: Heretic
metas.description: Single-location psychological horror. Two young missionaries are forced to prove their faith when they knock on the wrong door and are greeted by a diabolical Mr. Reed, becoming ensnared in his deadly game of cat-and-mouse.

metas.name: Ready or Not
metas.description: Home-invasion horror comedy. A young bride's wedding night turns into her worst nightmare when her ridiculously rich in-laws force her to play a gruesome game of hide-and-seek.

metas.name: Oddity
metas.description: Creepy supernatural mystery. After the brutal murder of her twin sister, Darcy goes after those responsible by using haunted items as her tools for revenge.

metas.name: Nope
metas.description: UFO horror with Disclosure Day themes. Residents in a lonely gulch of inland California bear witness to an uncanny, chilling discovery.

metas.name: Host
metas.description: Found-footage seance horror in under an hour. Six friends hire a medium to hold a séance via Zoom during lockdown — but they get far more than they bargained for as things quickly go wrong. When an evil spirit starts invading their homes, they begin to realise they might not survive the night.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: Video-game world adventure like Ready Player One. A bank teller discovers he is actually a background player in an open-world video game, and decides to become the hero of his own story. Now, in a world where there are no limits, he is determined to be the guy who saves his world his way before it's too late.

metas.name: Hell House LLC
metas.description: Found-footage haunted house cult favorite. Five years after an unexplained malfunction causes the death of 15 tour-goers and staff on the opening night of a Halloween haunted house tour, a documentary crew travels back to the scene of the tragedy to find out what really happened.
